what: How fields.parquet was built. A side file for humans; not part of the data contract (schema.md).

crop history (USDA NASS Cropland Data Layer via CropScape, one county raster per year)

csb.filter: bbox of the county outline padded by 5000 m AND STATEFIPS = '20' AND CNTYFIPS = '055'

cdl.majority_rule: plurality of pixels whose centre is inside the polygon; values 0/nodata/81 do not vote; polygons with no pixel centre use all touched pixels; ties -> lowest code

agreement_with_csb_attributes.what: raster-majority CDL class (this pipeline) vs the CSB polygon's own CDL<year> attribute

fields.field_id_rule: state abbreviation + 6-digit rank among ALL county CSB polygons sorted by CSBID (before any filter; ids have gaps)
caveats: CDL is a satellite classification, not ground truth: single-year errors (especially grass/pasture vs fallow/alfalfa/other hay) appear in histories as they are.
The crop of a field-year is the plurality class of its pixels; mixed or split fields get the largest share's class (see majority_share in the provenance).
Ties between classes go to the lowest CDL code.
CSB outlines are derived by NASS from 8 years of CDL at 30 m, not surveyed boundaries; they describe the 2018-2025 crop sequence, while histories cover 2008-2024.

soil.source: USDA-NRCS SSURGO via Soil Data Access (SDA)

method.attribute: chorizon.om_r (organic matter, percent by weight of the <2 mm fraction, representative value)
method.surface_horizon: smallest hzdept_r per component; an organic O horizon is skipped when a mineral horizon starts within 20 cm of the surface; no substitution from deeper horizons when om_r is null
method.map_unit: comppct_r-weighted mean over all components with a non-null surface om_r, weights renormalised; null when no component has a value
method.field: mean of the map unit values weighted by intersection area in EPSG:5070, null map units ignored and weights renormalised; NaN only when no part of the field has a value

tile_scheme.alignment: tile (ix, iy) covers lon [ix/10, (ix+1)/10], lat [iy/10, (iy+1)/10]; fixed grid, independent of the field set

queries.mupolygon_tile: SELECT P.mupolygonkey, P.mukey, P.areasymbol, P.musym, P.mupolygongeo.STAsText() AS wkt FROM SDA_Get_Mupolygonkey_from_intersection_with_WktWgs84('{wkt}') AS K INNER JOIN mupolygon AS P ON P.mupolygonkey = K.mupolygonkey
queries.mupolygon_tile_example: SELECT P.mupolygonkey, P.mukey, P.areasymbol, P.musym, P.mupolygongeo.STAsText() AS wkt FROM SDA_Get_Mupolygonkey_from_intersection_with_WktWgs84('POLYGON((-101.2 37.8, -101.1 37.8, -101.1 37.9, -101.2 37.9, -101.2 37.8))') AS K INNER JOIN mupolygon AS P ON P.mupolygonkey = K.mupolygonkey
queries.mapunit_attributes: SELECT mu.mukey, mu.musym, mu.muname, mu.mukind, l.areasymbol, c.cokey, c.compname, c.compkind, c.comppct_r, c.majcompflag, ch.chkey, ch.hzname, ch.desgnmaster, ch.hzdept_r, ch.hzdepb_r, ch.om_r FROM mapunit AS mu INNER JOIN legend AS l ON l.lkey = mu.lkey LEFT JOIN component AS c ON c.mukey = mu.mukey LEFT JOIN chorizon AS ch ON ch.cokey = c.cokey WHERE mu.mukey IN ({mukeys}) ORDER BY mu.mukey, c.cokey, ch.hzdept_r
queries.survey_areas: SELECT areasymbol, areaname, saversion, saverest FROM sacatalog WHERE areasymbol IN ({areasymbols}) ORDER BY areasymbol

coverage.definition: om_coverage = share of the field area on map units that have an organic matter value

slope.method: Horn 3x3 finite differences on the DEM's native lon/lat grid; per-row metric pixel size on the GRS80 ellipsoid (dx = N(lat)*cos(lat)*dlon, dy = M(lat)*dlat); slope_pct = 100*sqrt((dz/dx)^2 + (dz/dy)^2); no resampling or reprojection; pixels with a missing elevation in their 3x3 window are excluded. Field value = unweighted mean of the slope pixels whose centre is inside the polygon (label raster + np.bincount, in bands of rows); fields that contain no pixel centre use all touched pixels, then the pixel under an interior point.
slope.horizontal_crs: EPSG:4269 lon/lat grid, used as EPSG:4326 (NAD83 vs WGS84 differ by ~1 m here)
